name: Motion Matching
author: Cassieandstuff
description: Community Behaviors' motion matching database: the locomotion clips (252, retargeted onto the Skyrim humanoid skeleton by Skyrim Content Tools' fbx-retarget, root motion on NPC Root), the motion-matching graph over them (Behaviors\MotionMatching.hkx) and their roster patches. Replaceable as a whole: a Dance Card Creator export of the same name placed above it in MO2 takes its place. Switching locomotion to this graph is the separate Motion Matching Wiring bundle.
